title: A Ember for the Salt
author: Hazel Nystrom
blurb: Wren Villalobos, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
